confirmedFindings.title: Event Payload Rename callId -> sipCallId Breaks CDR Ingestion
confirmedFindings.body: Renaming event property callId to sipCallId in the shared call_event payload breaks downstream event consumers in cdr_pipeline/src/cdrIngestion.ts which extract event.callId to record call progress.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Maintain backwards compatibility by emitting both callId and sipCallId or updating all subscriber modules across the monorepo.
